about: Replay each case against the buffering-quality controller with a fake wall clock. Apply each event at its time t (ms on the case clock), advancing the clock between events so timers fire, then advance to until. expect is the complete ordered list of outputs; any other output fails the case. A case's mode defaults to defaults.mode. buffering_action, when present, is the plan_summary value each listed plan must report. Trigger evaluation occurs on playing and an in-progress long-stall timer, not on waiting or suppression expiry while playing. Suppressed history is retained; timeout and rearm clear it. Plan labels identify local adoptions, not unique server plan IDs; a server plan_id may repeat. Compute the step-down estimate as the exact integer floor of delivered_kbps * 7 / 10.

copy.cant_lower: Can't lower quality for this video

cases.name: grace
cases.note: The first stall ends before the grace does, so only one stall counts.

cases.name: slow_start
cases.note: No frame yet, so the grace runs from the first wait.

cases.name: outage
cases.note: The stall is re-timed when transport recovers, so it counts as one 1000 ms stall.

cases.name: lower_again
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.

cases.name: picked_quality
cases.note: always still asks about a quality the viewer picked.

cases.name: timeout
cases.note: The second trigger, at 191000, is inside REOFFER_MIN_MS of the first offer.

cases.name: unadopted_replan
cases.note: Rearm counts from the replan at 131000, so the stall at 156000 is ignored and the one at 206000 is not.

cases.name: back_hides_undo_without_answering
cases.note: The undo pill times out at 149000; the lower plan keeps playing.
